limitations: The contact single-passage and retained-order claim depends on a circular-thickness axle and local bend radius at least d/2, with the stated sleeve geometry; bead diameter or persistence length alone does not establish this assumption.

The reported elastic-energy floor is local and relative to a straight segment. It is not an activation free-energy barrier or a retention-time prediction; pre-existing strain, applied work, entropy, stiffness changes and cross-section deformation may affect practical barriers.

The one-/two-spectator guarantees are scoped to the ideal 3D Gaussian-span model and their stated convexity operations. The convex one-spectator penalty example is a mathematical diagnostic, not a chemical interaction, and higher derivatives may require higher moments.

A unique crossing does not establish uniform spectator entropy: the angular Jacobian and all sleeve, axle, handle and neighboring-ring interactions must be included. The required uniform-spectator/Gaussian interface remains unacquired.

The correlated Gaussian-linker criterion preserves axle/handle correlations and assumes the stated covariance matrices come from the same loaded ensemble; it does not establish a molecular attachment implementation.

CB7/PEG remains a chemical lead only. Separate pumping and crosslinking evidence does not establish ordered functionalized/native rings that remain mobile after selective connection. Molecular realization is unacquired.

The earlier constrained residence pilot remains neither equilibrium-curvature nor molecular sliding-speed evidence. No physical experiment, practical advantage, exact novelty or priority is established.

The complete return is producer material. The supplied review is source-exposed programme judgment, not an independent proof or computational replay; this integration ran no scientific code or data analysis.
